name: @testlab/framework
description: The WebdriverIO runtime that generated specs are written against: resilient interactions, readable failures, and per-platform config factories.
//: Authored as plain ESM rather than TypeScript on purpose. Generated specs are JavaScript executed by `wdio run` with no ts-node in the chain, so a compile step between writing a spec and replaying it would be a build failure mode sitting in the middle of the verification path. Types ship as hand-written .d.ts alongside.
